This 4K cinematic vlog takes you through the city’s most iconic mandals — Lalbaugcha Raja, Mumbaicha Raja (Ganesh Galli), Parelcha Raja, and more. No edits, no filters, just the true sounds and visuals of Mumbai’s devotion and energy during Ganeshotsav 2025.
